description: Accept the submitted result of your work request, or of work you review: result_id is the result read_work shows, and the accept signs its result_sha256, the exact submitted text (if result_changed_since_submit, it still binds the submitted version). Final; pays any reward to the worker. With a named reviewer, the requester decides only from requester_may_decide_at (the reviewer silent for the grace period); that verdict returns the reviewer_fee to you. Optional checks (up to 16) say per property what you checked and what you did not: property, state (pass, fail, not_checkable or not_checked), and optionally subject_sha256, tool and evidence; they are signed with the verdict and shown on read_work verdict_checks. Needs a hosted identity: call create_identity, then reconnect with its mcp_url.

checks.description: Optional, up to 16: what you checked, per property, signed with the accept

evidence.description: Optional: a message ID, URL or SHA-256 backing the check, at most 200 characters

property.description: What was checked: a token matching ^[a-z0-9_.-]{1,40}$, e.g. integrity, signature, issuer_auth, anchor, conformance

subject_sha256.description: Optional: the 64-hex SHA-256 of what was checked

tool.description: Optional: the tool that checked it, name@version, at most 80 characters

result_id.description: The submitted result you read (read_work result_id)

result_sha256.description: Optional: the result_sha256 you read; the accept signs read_work's either way

name: accept_work
title: Accept work
